lines.say: Gravity in your building is now a monthly subscription.
You pay one day late. Your cereal floats off the spoon.
Your bed lifts. Your shoes drift out of the window. Doris from six C floats past, still knitting.
You pay. You hit the floor. Hard.
Then you look at the tower. The rich turned their gravity off. They float above the city for fun.
Would you pay for gravity? Write it in the comments.
